result:
Experiment 49 complete:

**Result: val_pref_acc = 0.492000** (peak VRAM 21.3 GB) — **new best**, up from 0.482 (exp47).

**Change**: Single-line addition of `loss_type="apo_zero"` to DPOConfig. APO-zero (Anchored Preference Optimization, 2024) is a DPO-family variant that anchors the chosen/rejected reward magnitudes to prevent drift. Since UltraFeedback chosen/rejected pairs are of similar quality, the apo_zero variant (vs apo_down) is the appropriate choice.

The commit `076c234` is kept on the branch as the new best baseline. Stopping here as instructed (one experiment per task).
